name: academic-ppt-rebuilder
description: Rebuild editable academic PowerPoint decks through a staged, owner-reviewed workflow.

interface.longDescription: Convert academic source materials, AI-generated slide reference images, target template style, extracted PNG asset packs, and real text into editable academic PowerPoint decks. The workflow is staged and requires Stage 2 content page images to pass owner review before template styling, asset extraction, or PPTX rebuild begins.
defaultPrompt: Use $academic-ppt-rebuilder to rebuild an editable academic PPT.
Use $academic-ppt-rebuilder with my PNG assets and slide refs.
